decisions.reason: The certified HVAC plate exchanger line sits close to the core offer, and the growing industry gives no shortfall against aspiration, so it is worth carrying despite only being mentioned on the website.
The firm claims a major market share in water cooling systems, which suggests results meet or exceed aspirations, so there is no trigger for search.
The marine cooling unit has its own page and complements the box cooler line, and slack from a growing, hiring firm allows it time to prove itself.
The compact oil cooler line builds on established competences, and with no evidence of a shortfall, low-visibility results do not justify dropping it yet.
The finned tube for air coolers is a component that strengthens the core air cooler business, has a dedicated page, and shows no sign of underperformance.
The enhanced tubes reflect the firm's in-house R&D and efficiency strategy, and with available slack and no performance gap it is kept while results mature.
